notes.title: Mini-Bugfixes V1.1.1
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
This update contains a couple small bugfixes, but most importantly it extends the New Years event and Kwanzaa event until the end of January 1st!

V1.1.1:

Mini-Bugfixes:
- Fixed New Years and Kwanzaa events not continuing on to January 1st of the new year
- Fixed an issue with the language dropdown saving the previously selected language for the next launch of the game
- Added the current sort mode to the hover text on the Dice Skin Sort Mode button in the customization menu

notes.title: V1.1.0 Happy Holidays Update!
notes.content:
V1.1.0:

Happy Holidays!
- Added support for a bunch of new holiday events for a bunch of different holidays!
- 42 new dice skins have been added to the game, spread out between all these holidays: New Years Eve, Hanukkah, Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, Eid Al-Adha, and Kwanzaa!
- For most of these events you'll have about a week for the event, but you can check information about when a current event ends in the Extra options menu so that you don't miss it!

Up first is Hanukkah starting tomorrow the 28th! After that, Christmas starting the 18th and Kwanzaa starting the 26th. Happy Holidays, and happy dice collecting!

notes.title: Fixed inventory drag face order issue hotfix! V1.0.10
notes.content:
V1.0.10:
A quick hotfix!
- Fixed a minor issue where the face you drag around in your inventory appeared behind the faces shown on the hover ring.
- Took the opportunity to make that face a prettier rounded shape!

notes.title: Halloween 2021 Update!
notes.content:
V1.0.9:

[b]Happy Halloween[/b]! This update adds the new Halloween Event to [b]unlock special skins[/b] and many other fixes and adjustments!

Balance influencing changes:
- Steal Face is now more common in early level chests and stores
- Enemy AI is much less likely to poison d1s that won’t get rerolled
- Rebound enemy should be a bit smarter about when it can actually make a useful move and when it should return a die

Fixes and features:
- Added the Halloween Event! It includes [b]18 new dice skins that can only be unlocked during the event[/b]. The event goes from a week before to a week after Halloween.
- Added a toggle in the extra settings that will prioritize special event unlocks (it’s on by default) and a list of current events and how many special event items are left to unlock.
- Improved the distribution of faces on the hover face ring when it has to adjust for the edge of the screen.
- The game will now tell you when there are no more normal dice materials left to unlock.
- Added a dice material sort mode button that will switch between sorting skins by order of unlock and alphabetical by skin name
- Fixed certain dice not getting outlined correctly
- Improved the enemy thinking spiral UI with hover text that explains what it is and a key combo (press Q and E at the same time) that will force the enemy to take the best move it has if it’s taking too long for your taste. (It really doesn’t take that long though and will only appear when it's taking longer than expected!)
- You beat ENEMY NAME on won battle screen should no longer overlap with later items for long enemy names
- Pausing the game in the credits menu will no longer cause issues (and you can use the pause menu to leave early!)
- Face names in blocking/healing menu UI should be spaced out nicer
- Dragging faces off the face inventory list will stop scrolling the inventory once your mouse leaves the inventory list
- Disabled moving around dice behind the blocking and healing menus
- Scrolling your dice in your dice bag with your scroll wheel is now disabled when you’re scrolling your dice faces so you can only scroll one at once
- When you have a very large hover UI text it should now clamp to stay on the screen

notes.title: V1.0.8 - General bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
V1.0.8 (the game launched as V1.0.7):

Balance influencing changes:
- Mad Scientist is given another damage dealing die with charge and reroll faces on it
- AI using the Reroll/Return faces will be slightly more likely to reroll/return dice if they have non-destroyed faces on them
- Flurry of swords faces no longer deal damage for a destroyed face
- Enemies that use separate faces will no longer separate the face from a d1. You can still do it though!
- Bosses will now block in a slightly smarter manner

Fixes and features:
- Added a changelog to the settings! Hello!
- Removed the invisible trash can on the playing field that was occasionally causing chaos!
- Fixed issue with high resolution screens launching at too high a resolution for the computer to run smoothly. On first launch the game will now set its resolution to the largest correct aspect ratio resolution that is narrower than 1920. If it’s smaller than the native resolution it will show a pop-up with a button that takes you to the graphics menu.
- Fixed a bug with opening the options menu the first time adjusting the resolution of the game
- The UI will now show the world number and map level in the bottom right when you aren’t highlighting a location on the map
- Added command line launch options to the game to make life a little easier:
    [b]resetlocalsettings [/b]=> Resets the settings for your local computer, things like resolution, volume settings, etc.
    [b]resetresolution [/b]=> The game will launch and set its resolution to the largest resolution at the correct aspect ratio equal to or narrower than 1920
    [b]resetresolutionmaxwidth <max width> [/b]=> the game will launch and set the resolution to the largest correct aspect ratio resolution equal or narrower than <max width>
    [b]width <#>[/b] => if you use both the width and height flags it’ll launch the game at that resolution.
    [b]height <#>[/b]
- Fixed an issue with the resolution list not correctly selecting the current resolution if your fullscreen mode doesn’t support changing the refresh rate
- Change game save menu has been fixed for what should be the last time
- Fixed a few mesh colliders that were angry with their settings
- Correctly load that you’ve already seen the animated credits from your save file when launching the game. You can still view them from the extra settings menu!
- Removed duplicate “faces sold” stat in the stats menu
- Fixed an occasional error that would pop up before the game loads but didn’t do much aside from print an error
- Fixed listing the wrong build version on the analytics
- Cleaned up some tutorial text
